initial_metadata_404.cause: New acquisition runner assumed a capinfos exists for Hakai; official index has none
initial_metadata_404.action: Restrict capinfos check to Hue; use Hakai official indices and README. No product change; no data had been downloaded at this failure

xz_memory_guard.justification: 64 MiB dictionary plus decoder overhead; bounded 96 MiB acquisition-only limit; extractor and auditor limits unchanged

hue_source_digest.proof: Replace only global header snaplen bytes 16..19 from 65535 to 262144 in a memory-only probe: resulting SHA-256 exactly equals published digest. No packet, file, timestamp or source label changed.

transport_metadata_recovery.cause: Initial Hue GET metadata not persisted before failed decompression
transport_metadata_recovery.action: Re-fetch only the same two authorized URLs, require exact byte identity, retain original files, persist verified transport before decompression; subsequent recovery reused these records

label_compatibility_blocker.action: No normalization or core edits; all 2200 Hue flows remain unlabeled; further adaptation stopped pending review

hue_readonly_candidate_diagnostics.difference_definition: expected minus observed uniquely supported candidate packets; includes all checksum states; does not constitute auditor admission
